name: notes-to-piano
description: Render a scanned music score into realistic PIANO audio (WAV/MP3). Takes the MusicXML/MIDI from the omr-notes skill and deterministically synthesizes it with FluidSynth and a CC-BY grand-piano soundfont — fully offline. Optional dynamics humanization, tempo override, and score PDF. Use after omr-notes, or whenever the user wants to HEAR a MusicXML/MIDI score as piano.
